# Truck-Safe Routing Historical Data Handoff

This package helps an authorized Organization technical team prepare historical operational data for Truck-Safe Routing review.

Use this order:

1. Read `TRUCK_SAFE_ROUTING_HISTORICAL_DATA_REQUEST.md`.
2. Complete `HISTORICAL_DATA_AVAILABILITY_QUESTIONNAIRE.md`.
3. Review the CSV templates.
4. Map source fields in `SOURCE_TO_TSR_MAPPING_WORKSHEET.csv`.
5. Generate the approved export from the Organization's source systems.
6. Complete `DELIVERY_OUTCOME_CODE_DICTIONARY_TEMPLATE.csv`.
7. Complete `HISTORICAL_DATA_EXPORT_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json`.
8. Complete `ORGANIZATION_DATA_EXPORT_CHECKLIST.md`.
9. Transfer the package through the approved secure channel.
10. Wait for Truck-Safe Routing dry-run validation results.

Receipt of an export does not mean the data has been accepted as representative. Truck-Safe Routing will run dry-run parsing, provenance checks, schema validation, quality checks, target validation, leakage review, and representativeness assessment before any predictive method evaluation.
